words.sanskrit: pura kila idam na kinchana asit

meaning.en: long ago, truly, nothing at all existed
meaning.hi: बहुत पहले, सच में, कुछ भी न था

words.sanskrit: na dyauh na antariksham na prithivi

meaning.en: no sky, no space between, no earth
meaning.hi: न आकाश, न अंतरिक्ष, न पृथ्वी

words.sanskrit: kevalam jyotih-rupam anadi-anantam

meaning.en: only a form of light, without beginning or end
meaning.hi: केवल ज्योतिरूप, अनादि-अनंत

words.sanskrit: anu-asthula-rupam arupam rupavat avijneyam

meaning.en: neither large nor small, without shape yet felt as if shaped, ungraspable
meaning.hi: न अणु न स्थूल, अरूप पर रूपवत, अविज्ञेय

words.sanskrit: jnana-rupam anandamayam asit

meaning.en: made of knowing, full of bliss
meaning.hi: ज्ञानरूप, आनंदमय

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tad ananyat tad dvedha abhut haritam ekam raktam aparam

meaning.en: that one divided into two, one green, one red
meaning.hi: वह एक दो भागों में बँटा, एक हरा, एक लाल

words.sanskrit: yad raktam tat pumsah rupam abhut yad haritam tan mayayah

meaning.en: the red became the form of Purusha, the green became Maya's
meaning.hi: लाल पुरुष का रूप बना, हरा माया का

words.sanskrit: tau samagacchatah tayoh viryam evam anandata

meaning.en: the two came together, their vitality grew delighted
meaning.hi: दोनों मिले, उनका वीर्य आनंदित हुआ

words.sanskrit: tad avardhata tad andam abhut haimam

meaning.en: it grew and became a golden egg
meaning.hi: वह बढ़ा और स्वर्णिम अंड बना

words.sanskrit: tad parinamamanam abhut tatah parameshthi vyajayata

meaning.en: it unfolded, and from it Parameshthi was born
meaning.hi: वह परिणत हुआ, उससे परमेष्ठी जन्मे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sah abhijijnasata kim me kulam kim me krityam iti

meaning.en: he wondered, what is my origin, what is my task
meaning.hi: उसने पूछा, मेरा कुल क्या है, मेरा कृत्य क्या है

words.sanskrit: vak adrishyamana abhyuvacha bho bho prajapate tvam avyaktat utpannah asi vyaktam te krityam iti

meaning.en: an unseen voice said: O Prajapati, you are born of the unmanifest, your task is in the manifest
meaning.hi: अदृश्य वाणी बोली: हे प्रजापति, तुम अव्यक्त से जन्मे, तुम्हारा कार्य व्यक्त में है

words.sanskrit: kim avyaktam yasmat aham asisham kim tad vyaktam yan me krityam iti

meaning.en: what is this unmanifest I came from, what is my manifest task
meaning.hi: यह अव्यक्त क्या है, यह व्यक्त कार्य क्या है

words.sanskrit: sa abravit avijneyam hi tat saumya tejah yad avijneyam tad avyaktam

meaning.en: she said: that light cannot be grasped by knowing, that is why it is unmanifest
meaning.hi: उसने कहा: वह तेज अविज्ञेय है, इसलिए अव्यक्त कहलाता है

words.sanskrit: tach chet jijnasasi ma avagacchati

meaning.en: if you wish to know it, do not reach it through thought alone
meaning.hi: यदि जानना चाहो, तो केवल विचार से मत पहुँचो

words.sanskrit: sa hovacha ka esha tvam brahma-vak yad asi shamsa atmanam iti

meaning.en: he asked: who are you, speaking these words of Brahman
meaning.hi: उसने पूछा: तुम कौन हो, ब्रह्मवाणी बोलने वाली

words.sanskrit: sa tu abravit tapasa mam vijijnasasva iti

meaning.en: she said: know me through disciplined effort
meaning.hi: उसने कहा: मुझे तप से जानो

words.sanskrit: sa ha sahasram samah brahmacharyam adhyuvasa

meaning.en: and so he lived in discipline for a thousand years
meaning.hi: और वह सहस्र वर्ष ब्रह्मचर्य में रहा

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: atha apashyat richam anushtubhim paramam vidyam

meaning.en: then he perceived the supreme knowledge in the Rig and Anushtubh meter
meaning.hi: तब उसने ऋचा-अनुष्टुभ में परम विद्या देखी

words.sanskrit: yasya angani anye mantrah

meaning.en: of which every other verse is a limb
meaning.hi: जिसके अंग बाक़ी सब मंत्र हैं

words.sanskrit: yatra brahma pratishthitam vishve devah pratishthitah

meaning.en: where Brahman is established, all the gods are established
meaning.hi: जहाँ ब्रह्म प्रतिष्ठित, वहाँ सब देवता प्रतिष्ठित

words.sanskrit: yah tam na veda kim anyaih vedaih karishyati

meaning.en: whoever does not know this, what will other Vedas do for them
meaning.hi: जो इसे नहीं जानता, उसके लिए अन्य वेद क्या करेंगे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tam viditva sah cha raktam jijnasayamasa

meaning.en: having known it, he sought to understand it further
meaning.hi: उसे जानकर, उसने और जिज्ञासा की

words.sanskrit: tam evam anuchanam gayan asishta sahasram samah adyanta-nihita-omkarena padani agayat sahasram samah tatha eva aksharashah

meaning.en: he sang it with Om at start and end for a thousand years, then syllable by syllable for a thousand more
meaning.hi: उसने सहस्र वर्ष ओंकार सहित गाया, फिर सहस्र वर्ष अक्षर-अक्षर पढ़ा

words.sanskrit: tatah apashyat jyotirmayam shriya alingitam suparna-ratham shesha-phana-achhaditam maulim mrigamukham naravapusham

meaning.en: then he saw a radiant being, embraced by Lakshmi, on Garuda's chariot, crowned by Shesha's hood, deer-faced, human-bodied
meaning.hi: तब उसने ज्योतिर्मय, लक्ष्मी-आलिंगित, गरुड़-रथी, शेष-फणाच्छादित, मृगमुख, नरवपु सत्ता देखी

words.sanskrit: shashi-surya-havya-vahana-atmaka-nayana-trayam

meaning.en: with three eyes made of moon, sun, and sacrificial fire
meaning.hi: चंद्र, सूर्य, हव्यवाहन रूप तीन नेत्र

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tatah prajapatih pranipapata namo nama iti

meaning.en: Prajapati bowed, saying I bow, I bow
meaning.hi: प्रजापति ने प्रणाम किया, नमो नमः कहते हुए

words.sanskrit: tatha eva richa atha tam astaut

meaning.en: and then praised him verse by verse
meaning.hi: और फिर श्लोकों से स्तुति की

words.sanskrit: ugram iti aha ugrah khalu va esha mriga-rupatvat

meaning.en: calling him Ugra, fierce, for his beast-form
meaning.hi: उग्र कहा, मृगरूप के कारण

words.sanskrit: viram iti aha virah va esha viryavattvat

meaning.en: calling him Vira, heroic, for his vitality
meaning.hi: वीर कहा, वीर्यवत्ता के कारण

words.sanskrit: maha-vishnum iti aha mahatam va ayam mahan rodasi vyapya sthitah

meaning.en: calling him Mahavishnu, filling heaven and earth
meaning.hi: महाविष्णु कहा, रोदसी व्याप्त

words.sanskrit: jvalantam iti aha jvalanniva khalu asau avasthitah

meaning.en: calling him Jvalanta, blazing
meaning.hi: ज्वलंत कहा, ज्वालामय स्थित

words.sanskrit: sarvatomukham iti aha sarvatah khalu ayam mukhavan vishvarupatvat

meaning.en: calling him Sarvatomukha, facing every direction
meaning.hi: सर्वतोमुख कहा, विश्वरूप के कारण

words.sanskrit: nrisimham iti aha yatha yajuh eva etat

meaning.en: calling him Narasimha, as the Yajurveda says
meaning.hi: नृसिंह कहा, यजुर्वेदानुसार

words.sanskrit: bhishanam iti aha bhisha va asmat adityah udeti bhitah chandrama bhitah vayuh vati bhitah agnih dahati bhitah parjanyah varshati

meaning.en: calling him Bhishana, terrifying, for whose fear sun, moon, wind, fire, rain all act
meaning.hi: भीषण कहा, जिनके भय से सूर्य, चंद्र, वायु, अग्नि, वर्षा

words.sanskrit: bhadram iti aha bhadrah khalu ayam shriya jushtah

meaning.en: calling him Bhadra, auspicious, attended by fortune
meaning.hi: भद्र कहा, श्री से युक्त

words.sanskrit: mrityoh mrityum iti aha mrityoh va ayam mrityuh amritatvam prajanam anna-adanam

meaning.en: calling him death of death, granting deathlessness to the food sustaining beings
meaning.hi: मृत्युमृत्यु कहा, अन्नादान को अमरत्व देने वाला

words.sanskrit: namami iti aha aham iti aha yatha yajuh eva etat

meaning.en: saying I bow, I am yours, as the Yajurveda teaches
meaning.hi: नमामि, अहम् कहा, यजुर्वेदानुसार

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: ugram viram maha-vishnum jvalantam sarva-tejasam

meaning.en: fierce, heroic, great Vishnu, blazing, all-radiant
meaning.hi: उग्र, वीर, महाविष्णु, ज्वलंत, सर्वतेजस्वी

words.sanskrit: nrisimham bhishanam bhadram mrityu-mrityum namami aham

meaning.en: Narasimha, terrifying, auspicious, death of death, I bow
meaning.hi: नृसिंह, भीषण, भद्र, मृत्युमृत्यु, मैं नमन करता हूँ

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: atha bhagavan tam abravit prajapate pritah aham kim tava ipsitam tat ashamsa iti

meaning.en: the Lord said: Prajapati, I am pleased, tell me what you wish, I will grant it
meaning.hi: भगवान ने कहा: प्रजापति, मैं प्रसन्न हूँ, जो चाहो बताओ

words.sanskrit: sa hovacha bhagavan avyaktat utpannah asmi vyaktam mama krityam iti pura ashravi

meaning.en: he said: Lord, I was born of the unmanifest, my task is in the manifest, as I heard before
meaning.hi: उसने कहा: भगवन्, मैं अव्यक्त से जन्मा, कार्य व्यक्त में है

words.sanskrit: tatra avyaktam bhavan iti ajnayi vyaktam me kathaya iti

meaning.en: please explain to me what this manifest actually is
meaning.hi: कृपया व्यक्त क्या है यह मुझे बताएँ

words.sanskrit: vyaktam vai vishvam chara-achara-atmakam

meaning.en: the manifest is the whole universe, moving and unmoving
meaning.hi: व्यक्त सम्पूर्ण चराचर जगत है

words.sanskrit: yad vyajyate tad vyaktasya vyaktatvam iti

meaning.en: whatever becomes visible is what manifest means
meaning.hi: जो प्रकट होता है वही व्यक्त का व्यक्तत्व है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: sa hovacha na shaknomi jagat srashtum upayam me kathaya iti

meaning.en: he said: I do not know how to create the world, teach me the method
meaning.hi: उसने कहा: मुझे सृष्टि करने का उपाय नहीं पता, बताएँ

words.sanskrit: tam uvacha purushah prajapate shrinu srishteh upayam paramam

meaning.en: the divine person said: Prajapati, hear the highest method of creation
meaning.hi: पुरुष ने कहा: प्रजापति, सृष्टि का परम उपाय सुनो

words.sanskrit: yam viditva sarvam jnasyasi sarvatra shakshyasi sarvam karishyasi

meaning.en: knowing which you will know all, be capable everywhere, accomplish everything
meaning.hi: जिसे जानकर सब जानोगे, सर्वत्र सक्षम होगे, सब करोगे

words.sanskrit: mayi agnau sva-atmanam havih dhyayet taya eva anushtubh richa

meaning.en: meditate on your own self as the offering into me the fire, through that Anushtubh verse
meaning.hi: मुझमें, अग्नि में, स्वात्मा को हवि रूप ध्याओ, उसी अनुष्टुभ ऋचा से

words.sanskrit: dhyana-yajnah ayam eva

meaning.en: this alone is the meditative sacrifice
meaning.hi: यही ध्यानयज्ञ है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: etad vai maha-upanishat devanam guhyam

meaning.en: this indeed is the great secret Upanishad of the gods
meaning.hi: यही देवताओं का महोपनिषद गूढ़ रहस्य है

words.sanskrit: na ha va etasya samna na richa na yajusha arthah nu vidyate

meaning.en: no purpose apart from it is achieved through Sama, Rig, or Yajur formulas
meaning.hi: इसके बिना साम, ऋचा, यजु से अर्थ सिद्ध नहीं होता

words.sanskrit: ya imah veda sah sarvan kaman avapya sarvan lokan jitva mam eva abhyupaiti

meaning.en: whoever knows this attains every desire, conquers every world, comes to me
meaning.hi: जो इसे जानता है, वह सब इच्छाएँ पाकर, सब लोक जीतकर मुझे प्राप्त होता है

words.sanskrit: na sah punah avartate ya evam veda iti

meaning.en: does not return again; so says one who knows this
meaning.hi: वह फिर नहीं लौटता; ऐसा जानने वाला कहता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: prajapatih tam yajnayam vasiyamsam atmanam manyamanah mano-yajnena ije

meaning.en: Prajapati, considering his own self the finest offering, performed a purely mental sacrifice
meaning.hi: प्रजापति ने आत्मा को श्रेष्ठ हवि मानकर मनोयज्ञ किया

words.sanskrit: sa-pranavaya taya eva richa havih dhyatva atmanam atmani agnau juhuyat

meaning.en: reciting Om with that same verse, meditating on offering the self into the self as fire
meaning.hi: प्रणव सहित उसी ऋचा से आत्मा को आत्मा में अग्नि रूप हवन किया

words.sanskrit: sarvam ajanat sarvatra ashakat sarvam akarot

meaning.en: he came to know everything, gained ability everywhere, accomplished everything
meaning.hi: उसने सब जाना, सर्वत्र सक्षम हुआ, सब किया

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yah evam vidvan imam dhyana-yajnam anutishthet sah sarvajnah anantashaktih sarvakarta bhavati

meaning.en: whoever, knowing this, practices this meditative sacrifice, becomes all-knowing, of unlimited power, doer of all
meaning.hi: जो यह जानकर ध्यानयज्ञ करता है, वह सर्वज्ञ, अनंतशक्ति, सर्वकर्ता बनता है

words.sanskrit: sah sarvan lokan jitva brahma param prapnoti

meaning.en: he conquers all worlds and attains the highest Brahman
meaning.hi: वह सब लोक जीतकर परब्रह्म प्राप्त करता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: atha prajapatih lokan sisrikshamanah tasyah eva vidyayah yani trimshat-aksharani tebhyah trin lokan

meaning.en: wishing to create the worlds, from the thirty syllables of that knowledge, he formed the three worlds
meaning.hi: लोक रचने की इच्छा से, विद्या के तीस अक्षरों से तीन लोक गढ़े

words.sanskrit: atha dve dve akshare tabhyam ubhayatah dadhara

meaning.en: then, two syllables at a time, he supported all things on both sides
meaning.hi: फिर दो-दो अक्षरों से दोनों ओर सहारा दिया

words.sanskrit: tasyah eva richah dvatrimshadbhih aksharaih tan devan nirmame

meaning.en: with thirty-two syllables of that verse, he formed the gods
meaning.hi: उसी ऋचा के बत्तीस अक्षरों से देवताओं को गढ़ा

words.sanskrit: sarvaih eva sah indrah abhavat

meaning.en: through all of them together he became Indra
meaning.hi: उन सबसे वह इंद्र बना

words.sanskrit: tasmat indrah devanam adhikah abhavat ya evam veda samananam adhikah bhavet

meaning.en: that is why Indra rose above the gods; whoever knows this rises above equals
meaning.hi: इसलिए इंद्र देवताओं से ऊपर उठे; जो जानता है वह समकक्षों से ऊपर उठता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tasyah ekadashabhih padaih ekadasha rudran nirmame

meaning.en: with eleven syllables, he formed the eleven Rudras
meaning.hi: ग्यारह पदों से ग्यारह रुद्र गढ़े

words.sanskrit: tasyah ekadashabhih ekadasha adityan nirmame sarvaih eva sah vishnuh abhavat

meaning.en: with another eleven, the eleven Adityas; through all he became Vishnu
meaning.hi: एक और ग्यारह से आदित्य गढ़े; सबसे विष्णु बने

words.sanskrit: tasmat vishnuh adityanam adhikah abhavat ya evam veda samananam adhikah bhavet

meaning.en: so Vishnu rose above the Adityas; whoever knows this rises above equals
meaning.hi: इसलिए विष्णु आदित्यों से ऊपर; जो जानता है वह ऊपर उठता है

words.sanskrit: sah chaturbhih chaturbhih aksharaih ashtau vasun ajanayat

meaning.en: with four sets of four syllables, he created the eight Vasus
meaning.hi: चार-चार अक्षरों से आठ वसु उत्पन्न किए

words.sanskrit: sah tasyah adyaih dvadashabhih aksharaih brahmanam ajanayat dashabhih dashabhih vit-kshatre

meaning.en: with the first twelve syllables he formed Brahmins, ten and ten more the people and warriors
meaning.hi: पहले बारह अक्षरों से ब्राह्मण, दस-दस से वैश्य-क्षत्रिय गढ़े

words.sanskrit: tasmat brahmanah mukhyah bhavati evam tan mukhyah bhavati ya evam veda

meaning.en: that is why the Brahmin is foremost; whoever knows this becomes foremost
meaning.hi: इसलिए ब्राह्मण मुख्य है; जानने वाला भी मुख्य बनता है

words.sanskrit: tushnim shudram ajanayat tasmat shudrah nirvidyah abhavat

meaning.en: quietly he formed the Shudra, who thus came to be without this knowledge
meaning.hi: चुपचाप शूद्र को गढ़ा, इसलिए शूद्र निर्विद्य हुआ

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse. This verse describes the ancient varna hierarchy as the source text presents it; the commentary situates it as a historical artifact rather than endorsing the hierarchy.

words.sanskrit: na vedam iva na naktam asit avyavritam

meaning.en: there was no distinct Veda, no distinct night, nothing separated
meaning.hi: न अलग वेद था, न अलग रात, कुछ अविभक्त था

words.sanskrit: sah prajapatih anushtubhabhyam ardharchabhyam ahoratrau akalpayat

meaning.en: Prajapati, using the two half-verses of Anushtubh, fashioned day and night
meaning.hi: प्रजापति ने अनुष्टुभ के दो अर्ध-श्लोकों से दिन-रात बनाए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tatah vyaichhat vi eva asma uchchhati atho tamah eva apahate

meaning.en: then it opened outward and darkness was pushed back
meaning.hi: फिर यह खुला और अंधकार दूर हुआ

words.sanskrit: rigvedam asyah adyat padat akalpayat yajuh dvitiyat sama tritiyat atharvangirasah chaturthat

meaning.en: the Rigveda from the first quarter, Yajur from the second, Sama from the third, Atharva from the fourth
meaning.hi: पहले पाद से ऋग्वेद, दूसरे से यजु, तीसरे से साम, चौथे से अथर्व

words.sanskrit: yad ashta-akshara-pada tena gayatri yad ekadasha-pada tena trishtup yat chatushpada tena jagati yad dvatrimshat-akshara tena anushtup

meaning.en: eight-syllable lines became Gayatri, eleven Trishtup, four Jagati, thirty-two Anushtubh
meaning.hi: आठ अक्षर गायत्री, ग्यारह त्रिष्टुप, चार जगती, बत्तीस अनुष्टुप

words.sanskrit: sa va esha sarvani chhandamsi ya imam sarvani chhandamsi veda

meaning.en: it holds every meter; whoever knows all these meters
meaning.hi: यह सब छंद समेटे है; जो इन सबको जानता है

words.sanskrit: sarvam jagat anushtubhah eva utpannam anushtup pratishthitam pratitishthati yah cha evam veda

meaning.en: the whole universe was born from Anushtubh and rests in it; so does one who knows this
meaning.hi: सम्पूर्ण जगत अनुष्टुभ से उत्पन्न और उसी में प्रतिष्ठित; जानने वाला भी वैसा ही प्रतिष्ठित रहता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: atha yada prajah srishta na jayante prajapatih katham nu imah prajah srijeyam iti chintayan ugram iti imam richam gatum upakramat

meaning.en: when the created beings were not reproducing, Prajapati, wondering how to bring them forth, began chanting the verse starting with Ugra
meaning.hi: जब प्रजाएँ स्वयं उत्पन्न नहीं हो रही थीं, प्रजापति उग्र-मंत्र गाने लगे

words.sanskrit: tatah prathama-padat ugra-rupah devah pradurabhut ekah shyamah puratah raktah pinaki stri-pum-rupah

meaning.en: from the first syllable a fierce deity appeared, dark and red, holding a trident, both female and male in form
meaning.hi: पहले अक्षर से उग्र देवता प्रकट हुए, श्याम-लाल, त्रिशूलधारी, स्त्री-पुरुष रूप

words.sanskrit: tam vibhajya strishu tasya stri-rupam pumsi cha pum-rupam vyadhat

meaning.en: dividing that form, he gave the female shape to women and male shape to men
meaning.hi: उस रूप को बाँटकर स्त्री को स्त्रीरूप, पुरुष को पुरुषरूप दिया

words.sanskrit: ubhabhyam amshabhyam sarvam adishtah tatah prajah prajayante

meaning.en: through both portions everything was fully ordered, and beings began to reproduce
meaning.hi: दोनों अंशों से सब पूर्ण हुआ, प्रजाएँ उत्पन्न होने लगीं

words.sanskrit: ya evam veda prajapateh sah api tryambakah imam richam udgayan udgrathita-jata-kalapah pratyak jyotishi atmani eva rantaram iti

meaning.en: whoever knows this about Prajapati, like Shiva chanting this verse with bound matted hair, delights resting in his own inner light
meaning.hi: जो प्रजापति के इसे जानता है, वह त्र्यम्बक की तरह जटाबद्ध होकर इस मंत्र को गाते हुए अपने ही तेज में रमता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: indrah vai kila devanam anujavarah asit

meaning.en: Indra was the youngest among the gods
meaning.hi: इंद्र देवताओं में सबसे छोटे थे

words.sanskrit: tam prajapatih abravit gachchha devanam adhipatih bhava iti sah agachchhat

meaning.en: Prajapati told him: go, become ruler of the gods, and he went
meaning.hi: प्रजापति ने कहा: जाओ, देवताओं के अधिपति बनो, वे गए

words.sanskrit: tam devah uchuh anujavarah asi tvam asmakam kutah tva adhipatyam iti

meaning.en: the gods said: you are our younger brother, how can you rule us
meaning.hi: देवताओं ने कहा: तुम छोटे भाई हो, कैसे शासन करोगे

words.sanskrit: sah prajapatim abhyetya uvacha evam devah uchuh anujavarasya kutah tava adhipatyam iti

meaning.en: he went back to Prajapati and reported what the gods said
meaning.hi: वे प्रजापति के पास लौटकर सब कह सुनाए

words.sanskrit: tam prajapatih indram tri-kalashaih amrita-purnaih anushtubha abhimantritaih abhishichya

meaning.en: Prajapati anointed Indra with three vessels of nectar consecrated by the Anushtubh verse
meaning.hi: प्रजापति ने अनुष्टुभ-अभिमंत्रित अमृत से तीन कलशों से इंद्र का अभिषेक किया

words.sanskrit: tam sudarshanena dakshinatah raraksha panchajanyena vamatah dvayena eva surakshitah abhavat

meaning.en: protected him with Sudarshana on the right and Panchajanya on the left, secured by both
meaning.hi: दाईं ओर सुदर्शन, बाईं ओर पांचजन्य से सुरक्षित किया

words.sanskrit: raukme phalake surya-varchasi mantram anushtubham vinyasya tad asya kanthe pratyamunchata

meaning.en: placing the sun-bright Anushtubh mantra on a golden plate, he tied it around Indra's neck
meaning.hi: स्वर्ण पट्टिका पर सूर्यतेजी अनुष्टुभ मंत्र रखकर गले में बाँधा

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: tatah sudurnirikshah abhavat tasmai vidyam anushtubhim pradat

meaning.en: he became hard to look upon; Prajapati gave him the Anushtubh wisdom too
meaning.hi: वे दुर्निरीक्ष्य हो गए; प्रजापति ने अनुष्टुभ विद्या भी दी

words.sanskrit: tato devah tam adhipatyaya anumenire sah svarat abhut ya evam veda svarat bhavet

meaning.en: the gods then accepted his rule; he became sovereign; whoever knows this becomes sovereign
meaning.hi: देवताओं ने उन्हें शासक माना; वे स्वराट बने; जानने वाला भी स्वराट बनता है

words.sanskrit: sah amanyata prithivim api katham apam jayeyam iti sah prajapatim upadhavat

meaning.en: he thought, how might I conquer the earth too, and went to Prajapati
meaning.hi: उन्होंने सोचा, पृथ्वी कैसे जीतूँ, प्रजापति के पास गए

words.sanskrit: tasmat prajapatih kamathakaram indra-naga-bhujaga-indra-adharam bhadrasanam pradat

meaning.en: Prajapati gave him a tortoise-shaped throne supported by the king of serpents
meaning.hi: प्रजापति ने कछुए-रूपी, नागराज-आधारित भद्रासन दिया

words.sanskrit: sah prithivim abhyajayat tatah sah ubhayoh lokayoh adhipatih abhut

meaning.en: he conquered the earth and became ruler of both worlds
meaning.hi: उन्होंने पृथ्वी जीती और दोनों लोकों के अधिपति बने

words.sanskrit: ya evam veda ubhayoh lokayoh adhipatih bhavati sah prithivim jayati

meaning.en: whoever knows this becomes ruler of both worlds and conquers the earth
meaning.hi: जानने वाला दोनों लोकों का अधिपति बनता है, पृथ्वी जीतता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yah va apratishthitam shithilam bhratrivebhyah vasiyan bhavati

meaning.en: whoever, though unsettled and loosely established, becomes wealthier than his kin
meaning.hi: जो अस्थिर, ढीला होते हुए भी परिजनों से अधिक समृद्ध बनता है

words.sanskrit: yah cha evam veda yah cha evam veda

meaning.en: whoever knows this, whoever knows this
meaning.hi: जो इसे जानता है, जो इसे जानता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: ya imam vidyam adhite sah sarvan vedan adhite

meaning.en: whoever studies this knowledge has studied every Veda
meaning.hi: जो इस विद्या को पढ़ता है वह सब वेद पढ़ता है

words.sanskrit: sah sarvaih kratubhih yajate sah sarva-tirtheshu snati

meaning.en: he performs every sacrifice, bathes at every sacred crossing
meaning.hi: वह सब यज्ञ करता है, सब तीर्थों में स्नान करता है

words.sanskrit: sah maha-patako-papatakaih pramuchyate sah brahma-varchasam mahat apnuyat

meaning.en: he is freed from great and lesser sins, attains the radiance of Brahman
meaning.hi: वह महापाप-उपपापों से मुक्त होता है, ब्रह्मवर्चस पाता है

words.sanskrit: a-brahmanah purvan akalpan cha uttaran cha vamshan punite

meaning.en: he purifies generations of his family, past and future
meaning.hi: वह पूर्व और उत्तर पीढ़ियों को पवित्र करता है

words.sanskrit: na enam apasmara-adayah rogah adidheyuh

meaning.en: afflictions like seizures never take hold of him
meaning.hi: मिर्गी जैसे रोग उसे नहीं पकड़ते

words.sanskrit: sa-yakshah sa-preta-pishachah api enam sprishtva drishtva shrutva va papinah punyan lokan avapnuyuh

meaning.en: even yakshas, ghosts, and demons, by touching, seeing, or hearing him, attain blessed worlds
meaning.hi: यक्ष, प्रेत, पिशाच भी उसे छूकर, देखकर, सुनकर पुण्य लोक पाते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: chintita-matrat asya sarve arthah siddhyeyuh

meaning.en: simply by thinking of it, all his aims are accomplished
meaning.hi: चिंतनमात्र से उसके सब कार्य सिद्ध होते हैं

words.sanskrit: pitaram iva enam sarve manyante rajanah cha asya adesha-karinah bhavanti

meaning.en: others regard him like a father; kings carry out his wishes
meaning.hi: सब उसे पिता समान मानते हैं; राजा उसकी इच्छा मानते हैं

words.sanskrit: na cha acharya-vyatiriktam shreyamsam drishtva namaskuryat na cha asmat upavarohet

meaning.en: he should bow to none but his teacher as superior, and never step down from this understanding
meaning.hi: गुरु के अलावा किसी को श्रेष्ठ मानकर न झुके, न इससे पीछे हटे

words.sanskrit: jivan-muktah cha bhavati dehante tamasah param dhama prapnuyat

meaning.en: he becomes liberated while living; at death's end reaches the highest abode beyond darkness
meaning.hi: वह जीवन्मुक्त होता है; देहांत पर तमस से परे धाम पाता है

words.sanskrit: yatra virat nrisimhah avabhasate tatra khalu upasate

meaning.en: where the majestic Narasimha shines, there seekers turn in devotion
meaning.hi: जहाँ नृसिंह प्रकाशित होते हैं, वहीं साधक उपासना करते हैं

words.sanskrit: tat-svarupa-dhyana-parah munayah akalpante tasmin eva atmani liyante na cha punaravartante

meaning.en: sages fixed on that form merge into that self and never return again
meaning.hi: उस रूप पर ध्यानरत मुनि उसी आत्मा में लीन होकर फिर नहीं लौटते

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: na cha imam vidyam ashraddadhanaya bruyat na asuyavate na anuchanaya

meaning.en: should not be told to one without faith, quick to fault, or improperly studied
meaning.hi: श्रद्धाहीन, दोषदर्शी, अनुचित रूप से पढ़े को न बताएँ

words.sanskrit: na avishnu-bhaktaya na anritine na atapase

meaning.en: nor to one without devotion to Vishnu, dishonest, or lacking discipline
meaning.hi: विष्णुभक्तिहीन, असत्यवादी, तपोहीन को न बताएँ

words.sanskrit: na adantaya na ashantaya na adikshitaya

meaning.en: nor to one whose senses are uncontrolled, unsettled, or uninitiated
meaning.hi: अदांत, अशांत, अदीक्षित को न बताएँ

words.sanskrit: na adharma-shilaya na himsakaya na abrahmachariṇe

meaning.en: nor to one unrighteous, harmful, or without the student's vow
meaning.hi: अधर्मशील, हिंसक, अब्रह्मचारी को न बताएँ

words.sanskrit: iti eshah upanishat

meaning.en: so concludes this Upanishad
meaning.hi: यही उपनिषद है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
